newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares end week mixed, index continues gains.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares end week mixed, index continues gains.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market ended the week to Thursday mixed, with the official index on the rise, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week 8.55 points higher at 2,458.76. Six stocks firmed, four eased and the rest were unchanged.
Brokers said al-Khazna Insurance suffered a noteworthy decline, dropping to 320 dirhams from 350 at the start of the week. The stock closed at 335 a week earlier.
Market leader telecommunications company Etislat was steady at 955 for the fourth consecutive week.
Shares in the Dubai Investment Company dipped 1.5 dirhams to close at 13.5. Oman and Emirates Investment Company inched up 0.5 dirhams to 9.0.
The Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co rose 10 dirhams to 1,025 after remaining unchanged last week. The Emirates Insurance Company was steady at 610 dirhams.
Among financial stocks in the news, the Abu Dhabi National Bank continued to firm, chalking up two dirhams to 427. The Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank rose to 325 dirhams from 300 a week ago.
For the fourth week running, Dubai Islamic bank was easier, falling to 173 from 174. -- Dubai Newsroom +9714-626990
